headline: Approved $10,149,973 airport administration building bond and bonds for Frost and South Lawrence East school roofs.
summary: Residents spoke during public comment about the city's order to remove tents at House of Mercy, a shelter that faced fines for its campsite. Members approved bonds for the airport administration building and for roof work at the Frost and South Lawrence East schools. They tabled a proposed change to snow and ice rules.
decisions: Approved $10,149,973 bond for the airport administration building, 8-0.
Approved $7,881,647 bond for the Frost Elementary School roof replacement.
Approved bond for the South Lawrence East Elementary School roof replacement.
Approved $70,000 from Cataldo ambulance services funds for the fire department EMS coordinator salary, 7-0.
Approved $40,316.80 payment of a prior year invoice, 7-0.
Tabled $280 spending for deaf and hard of hearing awareness, 7-0.
Approved naming the Lawrence Police Department community room for Lieutenant Charles M. Saindon, 7-0.
Approved the appointment of Elvis A. Lora to the Lawrence Cultural Council, 7-0.
Withdrew the Zoning Board of Appeals appointment of Sheila Cabrera and the new Police Department executive assistant position, 7-0.
Withdrew seven tax, budget, and ARPA items from the agenda, 7-0.
Ordered a public hearing on the Fiscal Year 2027 property tax classification, 7-0.
Withdrew items 11-25 and 490-25, including parking at 8 Henlow Street.
Tabled the snow and ice operations ordinance change, 6-1.
Approved handicap parking on the west side of Greenwood Street, 7-0.
Approved handicap parking on Fairmont Street and Union Street, 7-0.
Approved a National Grid pole on Marston Street at Brookline Street.
Kept the public hearing on the Highway Access 2 Overlay District open until December 1, 2026, 7-0.
Tabled the Highway Access 2 Overlay District zoning item again, 7-0.
discussion: House of Mercy tents: Speakers criticized the city's order to remove tents and the fines against the group. The group's director said tents on private property are allowed and asked whether the city or state has a solution.
School roof timing: Members asked when the Frost and South Lawrence East roofs would be replaced. Officials said the work would be done in summer 2027, while students are out of school.
Snow and ice ordinance: Members said any change needs public notice. They debated whether to order a public hearing before the draft language was ready.
Police room naming: Members said the naming corrected an error made after signs went up without council approval.
Department attendance at votes: Members said department heads should attend when they seek approval. They tabled a $280 request after the department's director was not present.
